subject: Code review: Changes requested for AMSD-2041

body.text: Code review identified issues that need to be addressed.

issues.description: AC#3 NOT MET — live_preview is dead code. setCommonConfig correctly destructures live_preview and calls (query as any).addParam('live_preview', live_preview.preview_hash), and createContentTypeQuery/createContentTypeEntryQuery correctly use rest operators (...commonConfig) to forward it. However, NONE of the 5 public functions (getEntry, getSingleEntry, getAllContentTypeEntries, findSingletonEntry, getSingletonEntry) destructure or forward live_preview to createContentTypeQuery/createContentTypeEntryQuery. They all use explicit destructuring without a rest operator (e.g., { contentTypeUid, referenceFieldPath, jsonRtePath, only, lang, includeFields }) so live_preview is silently dropped at every call site. The setCommonConfig live_preview handling is unreachable dead code — preview context can never flow through to Contentstack queries, directly contradicting AC#3 and prior review feedback: 'query config interfaces lack live_preview fields to forward preview context through to Contentstack queries'.
issues.suggestedFix: Add live_preview to the destructuring of each public function and forward it to the createContentTypeQuery/createContentTypeEntryQuery call. For example, in getEntry: change the destructuring to include live_preview and pass it in the factory.createContentTypeQuery({...}) call object. Do the same for getSingleEntry, getAllContentTypeEntries, findSingletonEntry, and getSingletonEntry. Alternatively, use a rest operator (...rest) in each public function's destructuring and spread it into the factory call.

issues.description: The Contentstack Stack mock does not include an addParam method. The setCommonConfig implementation calls (query as any).addParam('live_preview', live_preview.preview_hash). If the forwarding blocker above is fixed and any test passes live_preview through to setCommonConfig, the test will crash with 'addParam is not a function' because the mock object has no such method.
issues.suggestedFix: Add addParam: jest.fn().mockReturnThis() to the jest.mock('contentstack') Stack mock object, alongside the existing methods like where, only, etc.

issues.description: AC#4 NOT MET — No test verifies that live_preview context actually flows through a public function (getEntry, getSingleEntry, etc.) to the Contentstack query's addParam method. The existing live preview tests only check the options object and setHost behavior. Since the forwarding code in setCommonConfig is dead code (see blocker above), no test can catch this regression. AC#4 requires tests covering live_preview behavior, and prior review feedback explicitly flagged missing tests. A test that calls getEntry (or similar) with a live_preview: { enable: true, preview_hash: 'test-hash' } parameter and asserts that the mock's addParam was called with ('live_preview', 'test-hash') is required to prove AC#3 is met.
issues.suggestedFix: Add a test in the 'live preview' describe block that calls getEntry (or another public function) with a live_preview: { enable: true, preview_hash: 'test-hash' } parameter and asserts that the mock's addParam was called with ('live_preview', 'test-hash').
